sermon.title: Jesus' Person and Purpose
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In “Jesus’ Person and Purpose,” Pastor David G. Kincer walks through Isaiah 44-53: restoration for God’s people and a light to the Gentiles, Cyrus named about 200 years ahead, Isaiah 50:4-6 on a word in season, Isaiah 52 on the marred Servant and kings shutting their mouths, and Isaiah 53 verse by verse, with his own story of hearing Isaiah 53 as a boy.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: he says “Matthew 13 23” for “I have foretold you all these things,” which is Matthew 24:25. The captions are auto-generated; names are capitalized (Chuck Smith, Cyrus, Elsinore, Philadelphia, Appalachian, Joseph of Arimathea; “Josephus” kept as heard), “grace whose griefs ours” in Isaiah 53:4 is read as “griefs, whose griefs? Ours,” and one garbled word is shown as [unclear]. He quotes Hosea 4:6, Revelation 5:9, Matthew 28:18, John 16:22 and others without naming the references. He names or alludes to Chuck Smith (says he predicted Christ’s return in 1982 and missed), the Muslims, Mary, and denominations, and makes remarks about homosexual activists, humanists and liberals as enemies of the church, men ruling their wives, “hillbillies” and “white trash,” elders without a calling, and the president and Congress. These are his own statements, kept as spoken; none have been checked here.

faqs.question: What does he say water baptism is?
faqs.answer: He says John the Baptist restored the message of repentance by water baptism for the forgiveness of sin, and that water baptism is putting our signature on his new covenant contract.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, “Indeed, Elijah is coming first and will restore all things.

faqs.question: Why does he say no man could have written the Bible’s predictions?
faqs.answer: He says no man could predict details and then see history follow through, such as the apostles predicting a falling away that nobody else in the first century expected.

faqs.question: What does he say about predicting when Christ returns?
faqs.answer: He says the end-time prophets give predictions of 5, 10 or 15 years that go by wrong, and that Jesus said nobody knows the day, only the Father.

scriptures.text_nkjv: “But of that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of heaven, but My Father only.

faqs.question: What does he mean that restoring believers is too easy for the servant?
faqs.answer: He says God told the servant that restoring Israel was too small a thing, and so gave him the tougher job of bringing in the rejecters and enemies of God.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Indeed He says, ‘It is too small a thing that You should be My Servant To raise up the tribes of Jacob, And to restore the preserved ones of Israel; I will also give You as a light to the Gentiles, That You should be My salvation to the ends of the earth.’ ”

faqs.question: What does he say the top gift is?
faqs.answer: He says the word of wisdom is the top gift, followed by the word of knowledge, and that tongues without interpretation do not teach the weary.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without hypocrisy.

faqs.question: Who does he give as examples of everlasting joy in hard times?
faqs.answer: He gives Peter in prison the night before he was to die and Paul and Silas in prison, who worshiped and praised God, and says Jesus said he would give joy that no man can take away.

scriptures.text_nkjv: So the ransomed of the LORD shall return, And come to Zion with singing, With everlasting joy on their heads. They shall obtain joy and gladness; Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

faqs.question: What does he mean by "your God reigns"?
faqs.answer: He says it means it does not matter if it looks like we are losing the battle, God is in control and in the end we win, so do not look at the circumstances or the news.

scriptures.text_nkjv: How beautiful upon the mountains Are the feet of him who brings good news, Who proclaims peace, Who brings glad tidings of good things, Who proclaims salvation, Who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

faqs.question: What does he say about Jesus coming at any minute?
faqs.answer: He says every prophecy has to be fulfilled before Christ comes, so he cannot come any minute, and that he loses a lot of people who believe strongly in the rapture and several years of tribulation.

faqs.question: What does he say about pictures of Jesus?
faqs.answer: He says the Bible says Jesus had no handsomeness, and that his message and character were what drew people, not his appearance after the beating.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For He shall grow up before Him as a tender plant, And as a root out of dry ground. He has no form or comeliness; And when we see Him, There is no beauty that we should desire Him.

faqs.question: What does he say we are healed from by his stripes?
faqs.answer: He says healed from sin, from depression, from a weak mind and from physical sicknesses, and that he is the healer.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But He was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities; The chastisement for our peace was upon Him, And by His stripes we are healed.

faqs.question: What does he say sin is?
faqs.answer: He says sin is breaking the law of God, and that the same word in our society is crime.

scriptures.text_nkjv: All we like sheep have gone astray; We have turned, every one, to his own way; And the LORD has laid on Him the iniquity of us all.

faqs.question: What does he say the church needs to do to declare his generation?
faqs.answer: He says the church needs to unite, get a goal, get organized and get the message out to homes, weep in prayer and say, here I am, use me, and the people can reject it but it is the church’s job to declare it.

scriptures.text_nkjv: He was taken from prison and from judgment, And who will declare His generation? For He was cut off from the land of the living; For the transgressions of My people He was stricken.

faqs.question: How does he say Isaiah 53:9 was fulfilled?
faqs.answer: He says Jesus died with the wicked because they said he was a wicked man, and was buried with the rich man Joseph of Arimathea, who gave his tomb, and that he had done no violence and no deceit was in his mouth.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And they made His grave with the wicked— But with the rich at His death, Because He had done no violence, Nor was any deceit in His mouth.
